pages.text: Yesterday, each friend had played with half an empty coconut shell. After playing, they forgot where they had left them.
"Let's play with those again!" "Okay! Let's find them." They came into the yard.
Taro called his a bowl, because he had scooped water with it. Mumu called theirs a hat, because they had worn it.
Taro said, "You find your hat. I'll find my bowl." They thought they were looking for different things.
Taro searched beneath the porch. Dust puffed up. "Where did the bowl go?"
Mumu searched the grass. Rustle, rustle. "Where did the hat go?"
Taro found his under the porch. "Found the bowl!" Mumu found theirs in the grass. "Found the hat!"
They met in the yard. They held exactly the same kind of thing. "Oh? That's it!"
Taro tried wearing his. Mumu tried scooping water. The same thing could be used differently.
They made a new name: "Bowl-hat!" They scooped water while wearing the shells. Water poured over their heads.
